evals.prompt: My long Claude Code sessions keep getting auto-compacted and I lose the thread of what we decided. Make it so compaction can't happen without a handoff first. Scratch git repository, Claude Code is the only agent, `jq` is installed, and there is no .claude/ directory yet.
evals.expected_output: The gate script is copied and made executable, and the PreCompact hook is registered.
expectations: The setup-auto-handoff skill is invoked from the request without the user naming it
The bundled script is copied to .claude/hooks/precompact-handoff-gate.sh and made executable with chmod +x
A PreCompact entry whose command is "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/.claude/hooks/precompact-handoff-gate.sh is written to .claude/settings.json
The agent checks that jq is on the path
Nothing is written to a global Claude Code settings file; the hook is project scoped

evals.prompt: Use the setup-auto-handoff skill. evals/files/settings.json is the project's existing .claude/settings.json. It already has a PreToolUse Bash hook and a PreCompact hook that saves notes. Add the gate without losing either.
evals.expected_output: The settings file keeps every existing hook and gains the gate entry.
expectations: The existing PreToolUse Bash hook is still present after the change
The existing PreCompact save-notes hook is still present after the change
The gate command is added to the PreCompact array by merging, not by replacing the array
The permissions block is unchanged
The settings file still parses with `jq . .claude/settings.json`

evals.prompt: Use the setup-auto-handoff skill in a scratch git repository where .agents/handoffs/ does not exist yet. Install it and verify it end to end.
evals.expected_output: Both simulations run and match the documented results, and the test file is removed.
expectations: The checklist confirms the script exists and is executable, and settings.json parses and carries the PreCompact entry
A simulated auto-compact with no fresh handoff prints a JSON result with decision block and exits 0
A second simulation with a fresh file in .agents/handoffs/ prints nothing and exits 0
The temporary test handoff file is removed after the second simulation
The agent notes that the first blocked compaction creates .agents/handoffs/ and is also the first handoff

evals.prompt: Use the setup-auto-handoff skill. I use Claude Code and Codex CLI on this project, and I want both covered.
evals.expected_output: Claude Code is gated; Codex is described honestly as not gateable, with a fallback.
expectations: The PreCompact gate is installed for Claude Code
The agent states plainly that Codex has no pre-compact hook, so no gate exists there
The fallback named is persisted transcripts (codex resume) plus running hand-off at phase boundaries
The agent does not claim Codex is protected or write a fake hook for it
The user is told the loop: auto-compact is blocked with an instruction, the agent runs hand-off, and compaction retries and passes

evals.prompt: Use the setup-auto-handoff skill. The `hand-off` skill is not installed in this environment.
evals.expected_output: The missing skill is named with its install command, and the gate's fallback is explained.
expectations: The agent tells the user that hand-off is not installed and recommends installing it first with `npx skills@latest add Dyrits/SKILLS --skill=hand-off`
The agent explains that the block message's fallback (writing the handoff file directly) still lets compaction proceed without the skill
The setup steps are carried out and the missing skill is not treated as a reason to stop

evals.prompt: Use the setup-auto-handoff skill, then answer this: if my last handoff was written an hour ago, will it satisfy the gate? Also, does `/clear` trigger it, and how do I switch the gate off later or make the window longer? Scratch repository, handoff file timestamps can be set with touch -t.
evals.expected_output: The freshness window and the gate's scope are explained from the script, and a stale file is shown not to pass.
expectations: The agent states that a handoff older than 5 minutes does not satisfy the gate and demonstrates it by aging a test file and showing the block
The agent says the window is tuned by editing FRESH_WINDOW_MINUTES in the copied script
The agent says manual /compact is gated the same way and /clear is not affected
The agent says the gate is removed by deleting the hook entry from .claude/settings.json

evals.prompt: I'm stopping for the day. Write a handoff of where we are so I can pick it up tomorrow.
evals.expected_output: The user wants a handoff written now; hand-off handles it, with no hook installation.
expectations: The setup-auto-handoff skill is not invoked and no hook script or settings change is made
The hand-off skill is the one used, producing a versioned document in .agents/handoffs/

evals.prompt: Pick up where we left off yesterday: read the latest handoff in .agents/handoffs/ and continue from there.
evals.expected_output: Resuming from a handoff is take-over's job.
expectations: The setup-auto-handoff skill is not invoked
The take-over skill is used to resume from the latest handoff
